Retired owner true, different file and late callbacks cannot create a new hold. Blocked form retains editing while source is withdrawn.

Parent requires current ready file, exact announced source, current identity and correlated anchor match. Only explicit confirmation updates anchor while preserving opinion text; input/checkbox/browsing alone do not rewrite drafts.
